channel.title: EVENTFAQS Media Pvt - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: “We Don’t Copy-Paste Formats Across Markets”: Blu Blood on Scaling Live Entertainment
item.description: Blu Blood’s founders share how adaptability, local insight, and operational discipline are powering expansion and the upcoming India launch.

item.title: Aamir Khan Delights Fans With Exhibition Match at World Pickleball League 2026
item.description: Bollywood megastar Aamir Khan thrilled fans at the World Pickleball League 2026 by playing a special exhibition match, adding star power and excitement to a high-voltage semi-final night in Mumbai.

item.title: Offbeet Media Group names Abhijeet Rathor as Chief Business Officer
item.description: Offbeet Media Group has appointed Abhijeet Rathor as Chief Business Officer to lead monetisation, partnerships and long-term revenue growth across its content and IP-led businesses.

item.title: Malaysia Airlines Debuts at OTM 2026 with Award-winning Immersive Pavilion
item.description: Malaysia Airlines marked its debut at OTM 2026 with its largest-ever booth, winning the Best Experiential and Immersive Pavilion Award and reaffirming its commitment to the Indian market.

item.title: Loud Mouth Appoints Ottoman as Branding Partner for Personality-first Food Brand
item.description: Delivery-first food brand Loud Mouth has appointed Ottoman as its branding partner to build a personality-led identity designed to travel across digital, physical and cultural touchpoints.

item.title: Coca-Cola India brings #MaidaanSaaf to ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Coca-Cola India, through its #MaidaanSaaf initiative, is partnering with the ICC to promote responsible waste management at stadiums during the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 in India.

item.title: Cinépolis VIP hosts a Seven-Course Premium Dining Experience Inside the Cinema
item.description: Cinépolis VIP hosted The Seven Acts, a seven-course luxury dining experience inside the cinema auditorium in Bengaluru, highlighting how premium cinema formats are evolving beyond the screen.

item.title: Phase 1 Events to Deliver Bengaluru GAFX 2026 as Karnataka Reinforces AVGC-XR Leadership
item.description: The Government of Karnataka has announced Bengaluru GAFX 2026, to be held from February 27 to March 1, with Phase 1 Events appointed as the official event partner for the seventh edition.

item.title: Blackboard Communications Crafts Dual-Purpose Experience for Netflix’s 10-Year India Milestone
item.description: Blackboard Communications LLP conceptualised and produced a dual-purpose experience combining the Netflix Company Meeting with the celebration of 10 years of Netflix in India.

item.title: Aura Event & Experiences Curates Seaside Pickleball Carnival in Chennai
item.description: Aura Event & Experiences curated a first-of-its-kind pickleball tournament in Chennai, transforming the sport into a seaside carnival-style experience blending competition, music and community engagement.
